h: מוֹצָאֵי יוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים, י׳ Motzei Yom Kippur, 10

p: It is brought in the Midrash
on "Behold, Esav my brother is a hairy man,
and I am a smooth man"
A parable of a curly-haired man and a bald man
who stood at the threshing floor;
the chaff flew onto the curly-haired one
So too Esav, the hairy man,
all the days of the year
and has nothing with which to atone;
is easily purified on Yom Kippur,
as it says, "For Hashem's portion is His people"
Now, to understand according to this exposition:
if so, why was he afraid of this,
And what would happen if they recognized this,
Would it not be even better in his eyes!
כִּי יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם חָשַׁב
that Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him, thought
that Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him,
recognized them in their true nature,
so that he could bring him into holiness;
מַה שֶּׁאֵין כֵּן יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם,
which is not so of Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
Yaakov made delicacies for his father,
and it is brought in the Midrash (ibid. 65:14):
for they correspond to the two goats.
to be eliminated from the world,
to subdue the level of Esav.
And through the delicacies that Yitzchak ate,
הִטְעִים לוֹ יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him, gave him a taste
also of the side of Esav,
so that there be refined from it for holiness
whatever is to be found in it;
what cannot be refined from it
And this was through the eating of rich foods
and the drinking of sweet drinks
of Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him.
And likewise the refinement takes place
בְּכָל יוֹם טוֹב שֶׁל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה,
on every Yom Tov of Rosh Hashanah,
And this is the reason that we say on these days,
"And all shall come to serve You
and shall recognize the power of Your kingship," etc.,
and let all works fear You,
and let all creatures bow before You," etc.,
because now is the time of the refining
of the vitality of the sparks of holiness
so that the good thing within them
as our Sages, of blessed memory, said
only so that converts would be added to them."
as we say in the prayers,
"And all wickedness will vanish entirely like smoke,
when You remove the dominion of evil
And the completion of the refinement
as is brought in the holy Zohar
on "And Esav returned on his way to Se'ir,
And this is also the reason
that seventy bulls are offered on the festival:
